second_order: calling people in to make a Hong Kong mark
theme_note: These passages recruit people, test whether enough manpower exists, or commit help; what varies is whether the call is general, conditional, local, or overseas.

second_order: working out what to draw and where it will fit
theme_note: These passages turn a wish for representation into a workable mark by proposing designs, coordinates, sizes and anchors, then rejecting options that will not fit or read clearly.

second_order: explaining the April Fools game to someone who asks
theme_note: One commenter asks what r/place is and another answers in the room's blunt, minimal terms; this exchange belongs with no other practice.

second_order: moving flag work into Discord and relaying it back
theme_note: These passages open, join, repair access to, or relay plans from Discord; thanks later distinguish helpers inside and outside that chat.

second_order: getting permission, protection and room beside others
theme_note: These passages negotiate coexistence with neighbouring groups: first securing green lattice territory and protection, then handling PPCG and PathofExile plans and thanking neighbouring helpers. Permission, conflict and redirection all vary within the practice.

second_order: building the flag and thanking the people who did it
theme_note: These passages report placing pixels or completing the flag and answer contributions with thanks, congratulations and an end-of-event celebration.

second_order: watching, defending and repairing the finished flag
theme_note: These passages shift from construction to keeping the established image intact across mismatched dots, sleep, and competing repair work elsewhere.

second_order: expanding, then aborting when people and room run out
theme_note: These passages propose a larger logo, stop it when PPCG conflict and limited manpower become clear, and redirect helpers toward tomorrow or PPCG.
regrouped_from: split during grouping review from calling people in and getting permission: the codes form a complete expansion-and-abort episode rather than another general recruitment or negotiation

second_order: arguing over which letters belong on the flag
theme_note: These late passages try to add HK or 香港, tag people covering letters, and object to or seek removal of the resulting lettering; the shared practice is revising the flag's wording, not agreement about its form.
